meta.project: Sistema de Gestión Deportiva — Selección de Voleibol UADY

product_overview: Web platform for managing the UADY volleyball team, with secure access by code and role-based views for athletes and admin staff. Users can log in, browse athletes, and view profile data with private information restricted to the athlete本人 and ADMIN users.
core_goals: Allow users to access the system through a unique access code
Let athletes view their own profile information and public teammate profiles
Let admin users view complete athlete profiles including private medical and contact data
Support admin control of athlete status through egresar and reactivar actions
Prevent athletes from viewing access codes or other athletes' private medical information

features.name: Login with access code
features.description: Users authenticate using a unique access code and are directed into the app once authenticated.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter access code -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated area
Navigate to /login -> Enter a valid athlete access code -> Submit the login form -> Access the athlete area
Navigate to /login -> Enter a valid admin access code -> Submit the login form -> Access the admin area

features.name: Own profile view
features.description: An authenticated athlete can open their own profile and review public, contact, and medical information available to them.
user_flows: Navigate to /perfil -> See the athlete's own academic information -> See the athlete's own sportive information -> See the athlete's own contact information including telefono tutor/familiar -> See the athlete's own medical information including NSS and insurance details
Navigate to /perfil -> Review the profile sections -> Confirm that no access code or clave is displayed anywhere on the page

features.name: Roster and teammate profile browsing
features.description: Authenticated users can view the athlete roster and open individual athlete profiles, with teammates seeing only public data.
user_flows: Navigate to /atletas -> Browse the roster of athletes -> Open another athlete's profile -> See that athlete's public profile information

Navigate to /atletas -> Browse the roster of athletes -> Open a teammate's profile -> See academic information -> See sportive information -> See reduced contact information without private contact details or medical data

features.name: Private profile visibility for ADMIN and self
features.description: Private contact and medical information is shown only to the athlete themselves or to ADMIN users when viewing athlete profiles.
user_flows: Log in as ADMIN -> Navigate to /atletas -> Open an athlete profile -> See academic information -> See sportive information -> See private contact information marked as private -> See medical data marked as private

Log in as an athlete -> Navigate to /atletas -> Open another athlete's profile -> See academic information -> See sportive information -> See contact information without private fields -> Do not see medical data
Log in as an athlete -> Navigate to /perfil -> See private contact information and medical data on the athlete's own profile

features.name: Admin athlete status actions
features.description: ADMIN users can mark athletes as egresado or reactivate them from the athlete profile page.
user_flows: Log in as ADMIN -> Open an active athlete's profile -> Choose to mark the athlete as egresado -> Confirm the action -> See the athlete status change to egresado
Log in as ADMIN -> Open an egresado athlete's profile -> Choose to reactivate the athlete -> Confirm the action -> See the athlete status change back to active

features.name: Admin athlete deletion confirmation
features.description: ADMIN users can open a deletion confirmation modal from an athlete profile and cancel without removing the athlete.
user_flows: Log in as ADMIN -> Open any athlete's profile -> Choose to delete the athlete permanently -> See a deletion confirmation modal with the athlete's name -> Cancel the dialog -> Return to the profile without deleting the athlete

tech_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

routes.description: Single-field login: input name=codigoAcceso. ADMIN code is ADMIN001 (dev seed button 'Crear Admin Maestro' creates it if missing). JUGADOR codes are seeded in prisma/seed.ts, e.g. ANA001, LAURA002.
Own-profile page for the logged-in athlete/admin (PerfilClient.tsx). Redirects to /login if no session.
Roster list, links to /atletas/[id] for each athlete.
Athlete detail/profile page viewed by another user (admin or teammate). Card visibility depends on session.rol and whether session.id === id.

features.name: Visibilidad de cards en perfil ajeno segun rol (privacidad)
features.description: In app/atletas/[id]/page.tsx, canViewPrivate = session.rol === 'ADMIN' || session.id === id. Always rendered: 'Informacion Academica' (inline dl) and CardDeportiva ('Informacion Deportiva'). CardContacto is ALWAYS rendered but with two distinct variants: variant='completo' (correo, telefonoPersonal, telefonoTutor + '🔒 Privado' badge) when canViewPrivate is true, vs variant='reducido' (ONLY correo and telefonoPersonal, no badge, no edit button) when false. CardMedica ('Datos Medicos', with '🔒 Privado' badge, shows NSS and 'Seguro Medico Privado') and the 'Historial Medico de Lesiones' table are conditionally rendered with `{canViewPrivate && (...)}` in JSX — when false, these are completely absent from the DOM (not just CSS-hidden), and the server query does not even include the relational `privado` field in that case (`privado: canViewPrivate` in the prisma select).
user_interactions: Log in as ADMIN (codigoAcceso=ADMIN001) and open /atletas/[id] for any JUGADOR athlete (e.g. ANA001's id) — exactly 4 cards must be present: 'Informacion Academica', 'Informacion Deportiva', 'Informacion de Contacto' (with text '🔒 Privado' badge, showing Correo, Telefono Personal, AND Telefono Tutor / Familiar), and 'Datos Medicos' (with '🔒 Privado' badge, showing an NSS value and a 'Seguro Medico Privado' value built from aseguradora/poliza/titular).

Log in as an athlete (codigoAcceso=ANA001) and open /perfil (own profile) — verify the same 4 sections of data are present (academic, sportive, contact with telefonoTutor, medical with NSS/seguro), and verify the page nowhere displays the athlete's own access code/clave (search rendered text for any 6-character alphanumeric code or a label like 'Clave' / 'Codigo de Acceso' — none should appear in /perfil).

Log in as an athlete (codigoAcceso=ANA001) and navigate to a teammate's profile at /atletas/[id] using a DIFFERENT athlete's id (e.g. LAURA002's id) — verify exactly 3 cards are visible: 'Informacion Academica', 'Informacion Deportiva', and 'Informacion de Contacto' WITHOUT any '🔒 Privado' badge text and showing ONLY Correo and Telefono Personal (the label 'Telefono Tutor / Familiar' must not appear anywhere on the page).

On that same teammate page, assert that the heading text 'Datos Medicos' is absent from the entire DOM (not present even in a collapsed/hidden state), and that no NSS-like value, insurance value, or access code appears anywhere on the page.

api_calls.endpoint: prisma.atleta.findUnique in app/atletas/[id]/page.tsx — select.privado is conditionally set to canViewPrivate (boolean), so the related AtletaPrivado row is never fetched/serialized for unauthorized viewers

features.name: Botones de accion administrativa visibles solo para ADMIN
features.description: In app/atletas/[id]/page.tsx, the entire admin-actions block (BotonEgresarAtleta / BotonReactivarAtleta + BotonEliminarAtleta) is wrapped in `{session?.rol === 'ADMIN' && (...)}`. Within that block, BotonEgresarAtleta ('Asignar como Egresado') shows when atleta.estado is 'ACTIVO', and BotonReactivarAtleta ('Reactivar atleta') shows when atleta.estado is 'EGRESADO'. BotonEliminarAtleta ('Eliminar atleta por completo') always shows alongside whichever of the two.
user_interactions: Log in as an athlete (codigoAcceso=ANA001), open a teammate's profile (a different athlete id) — verify none of the buttons 'Asignar como Egresado', 'Reactivar atleta', or 'Eliminar atleta por completo' are present anywhere on the page.

Log in as ADMIN (codigoAcceso=ADMIN001), open the profile of an athlete currently in estado ACTIVO — verify both 'Asignar como Egresado' and 'Eliminar atleta por completo' buttons are visible, and 'Reactivar atleta' is NOT present.

As ADMIN, open the profile of an athlete currently in estado EGRESADO (or one egresado via the flow below) — verify 'Reactivar atleta' and 'Eliminar atleta por completo' are visible, and 'Asignar como Egresado' is NOT present.

features.name: Flujo Egresar / Reactivar atleta (modal de confirmacion + toast)
features.description: BotonEgresarAtleta opens a confirmation modal (heading '¿Marcar a {nombre} como egresado?') with Cancelar/'Si, egresar' buttons. Confirming calls server action egresarAtleta(atletaId) (app/actions/atleta.actions.ts), closes the modal, and shows a green-bordered toast '{nombre} ha sido registrado como egresado correctamente' that auto-hides after ~4s. The page then re-renders with estado=EGRESADO, so BotonReactivarAtleta ('Reactivar atleta') replaces the egresar button. Confirming that modal calls reactivarAtleta(atletaId), shows toast '{nombre} ha sido reactivado correctamente', and the athlete returns to estado ACTIVO.
user_interactions: As ADMIN, on an ACTIVO athlete's profile (use a teammate other than ANA001/LAURA002 if available, e.g. the athlete with codigoAcceso SOFIA003, to avoid disturbing the other test fixtures), click 'Asignar como Egresado' — a modal appears containing the athlete's full name in the heading text.
Click 'Si, egresar' in the modal — the modal closes, a success toast with the athlete's name appears, and the page now shows the 'Reactivar atleta' button instead of 'Asignar como Egresado'.

Click 'Reactivar atleta' — a confirmation modal appears containing the athlete's name; click 'Si, reactivar' — verify a success toast appears and the page reverts to showing 'Asignar como Egresado' (estado is ACTIVO again).

features.name: Modal de eliminacion de atleta (sin eliminar al cancelar)
features.description: BotonEliminarAtleta renders a button 'Eliminar atleta por completo' that opens a modal dialog (not inline red text) titled '¿Eliminar permanentemente a {nombre}?' with Cancelar / 'Si, eliminar definitivamente' buttons. Clicking Cancelar (or clicking the dark overlay) closes the modal via local state with no server action invoked — the athlete is not deleted. Only confirming calls eliminarAtletaPorCompleto(atletaId).
user_interactions: As ADMIN, on any athlete's profile, click 'Eliminar atleta por completo' — verify a modal dialog (overlay + centered white card, not an inline red paragraph) appears containing the athlete's full name in the heading '¿Eliminar permanentemente a {nombre}?'.

Click 'Cancelar' in that modal — verify the modal closes immediately, no toast/error appears, and reloading or revisiting the athlete's profile shows the athlete still exists with all of their data intact (must NOT actually delete; do not click 'Si, eliminar definitivamente').

api_calls.endpoint: eliminarAtletaPorCompleto(atletaId) in app/actions/atleta.actions.ts — ONLY exercise the Cancelar path in this test, never confirm the delete
